title: Electronic · stage pianos
blurb: The red and black boxes on the stand: weighted keys, modelled and sampled grands, and a quarter-inch cable.

items.d: 2019 · Yamaha — the stage piano with three piano models and no menu diving.
2023 · Yamaha — the portable grand with CFX and Bösendorfer samples.
2017 · Roland — the stage flagship with two sound engines and an LED-fader interface.
2021 · Roland — the portable with the PHA-50 action and modelled piano tone.
2023 · Clavia — the Swedish red stage piano: organ, piano and synth in one.
2017 · Kawai — the stage piano with a wooden-key action.
2022 · Casio — the slim Privia with a spruce-cone speaker system and a wooden top.
2024 · Korg — the stage piano built around seven engines and a tube-driven output stage.
